development_evidence.warning: There is no independent retrospective test: every nominal test row appears in training or validation under another seed.

structured_comparator.selection_reason: modal nested-tuning choice in 3 of 5 development splits
structured_comparator.threshold_source: five-fold channel-grouped out-of-fold predictions over the full retrospective development cohort; random_state 20260903

multimodal_finalist.selection_reason: selected in 4 of 5 nested development splits

visual_encoder.frame_aggregation: arithmetic mean of all available stored samples, target 20

multimodal_finalist.preprocessing: fit each block's imputation, encoding and standardisation on retrospective training data only
multimodal_finalist.threshold_source: five-fold channel-grouped out-of-fold predictions over the full retrospective development cohort; random_state 20260903
multimodal_finalist.explanation: exact standardized input-block decomposition of the linear logit; predictive, not causal

eligibility: English-language video in one of the four principal categories
first observed less than 24 hours after publication
channel absent from the retrospective archive
external_test.outcome: view count at 30 days, interpolated only between bracketing snapshots
external_test.label: top quartile within category by first-observed channel-size tertile; tertiles and quartiles computed on the eligible external cohort
external_test.media_policy: download and extract the frozen content modalities only after the 30-day tracking window
external_test.primary_comparison: multimodal AUC-ROC minus structured-comparator AUC-ROC on the same eligible videos
external_test.inspection_rule: Do not inspect external labels, per-video predictions, aggregate metrics, or attribution examples until both fitted models and the eligible video manifest are locked.
external_test.status: not yet mature; no external-test metric has been computed
